Rashi on Menachot 13a:11:1.hebrew: אין מפגלין בחצי מתיר - שאם חישב לעבוד למחר עבודת חצי מתיר, הוא דפליג ר' יוסי:
Rashi on Menachot 13a:11:1.english: One does not render [an offering] piggul with half a permitting factor - That if one intended to perform the service of half a permitting factor tomorrow, that is where Rabbi Yosei disagrees.

Rashi on Menachot 13a:8:1.hebrew: מה שינה זה מן הזבח - ששוחטו ע"מ להקטיר אימוריו למחר, פיגול:
Rashi on Menachot 13a:8:1.english: How is this different from an animal offering - Where one slaughters it with the intention of burning its sacrificial portions tomorrow, it is piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 13a:8:2.english: Is not part of - The meal offering: [This] is explained in the Gemara.
